articles.title: Michael Mann Recuts Miami Vice for October Beyond Fest World Premiere
articles.summary: Writer-director Michael Mann is taking another crack at his 2006 film, Miami Vice. It was announced today that Miami Vice: Director’s Final Cut will make its world premiere at Beyond Fest in Los Angeles on October 3, 2026, followed by a Q&A with Mann.
body: It is described as “Michael Mann’s new cut” and that it will be shown in 4K. The Beyond Fest site doesn’t list the running time of this new cut.

If this version is truly a “new cut" then it will be an even different version of the film than the Miami Vice: Unrated Director’s Edition that was released on Blu-ray in 2008. The Unrated Director’s Edition is a re-edited film featuring scenes that were cut from the theatrical release as well as new music cues.

“These changes are enough to make this Miami Vice a slightly different and in some ways better experience than the theatrical cut, although the film's same fundamental flaws remain,” as I wrote in my review of the Unrated Director’s Edition at the time.

“This edition, however, is closer in tone to the TV series [which Mann exec produced but did not create], enough to have muted some of that criticism. For example, it opens with an offshore speedboat race set against the sunny Miami skyline and scored with electronic music, which conjures memories of the series' opening credits.”
points: Writer-director Michael Mann is taking another crack at his 2006 film, Miami Vice.
It was announced today that Miami Vice: Director’s Final Cut will make its world premiere at Beyond Fest in Los Angeles on October 3, 2026, followed by a Q&A with Mann.
It is described as “Michael Mann’s new cut” and that it will be shown in 4K.

articles.title: Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy's Surprise Switch 2 Port Has Some Fans Hoping for a Sequel
articles.summary: Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy has re-emerged, five years after its release, with a new Switch 2 version... and some fans hope it could lead to a sequel. During today's Nintendo Direct, fans were surprised to learn that Eidos Montreal's Guardians of the Galaxy game is coming back.
body: Now, this new release has some hoping that the Guardians may live on. Over on social media, excited fans are pleading to Marvel and Eidos Montreal to produce a sequel. Maybe a Switch 2 version could be used to test the waters, but it's hard to say. Either way, it's great to see such a beloved game finding its way back into the market, and hopefully, it can create some demand for another entry in the series.

"Don’t sleep on this game, Switch players. It’s fu**ing dope," said one fan. "Do yourself a favor and pick this up! It’s a GREAT game! I hate the fact that this gem got overlooked (and Midnight Suns as well btw)," noted another.
"Can we just get a sequel? The people have been asking for years," asked another fan. "Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy 2, please," another pleaded.

These are far from the only people asking for a sequel or begging new players to check it out; the comments under the announcement posts from Marvel Games and the game's official account are flooded with similar responses.
points: Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy has re-emerged, five years after its release, with a new Switch 2 version... and some fans hope it could lead to a sequel.
During today's Nintendo Direct, fans were surprised to learn that Eidos Montreal's Guardians of the Galaxy game is coming back.

articles.title: A Full-Fledged Skyrim Mod Starring Matt Berry Is Here To Refresh The Game With An Ikea Ad
articles.summary: I am not enthusiastic about what feels like an inevitable future wherein games and gaming subscription services are inundated with advertisements. That said, I am excited to reinstall Skyrim so I can play an elaborate Ikea ad.
body: Newly released on Bethesda's Creations site, Kallax Storageborn is a remarkably in-depth Skyrim mod that features the titular Ikea item. But rather than simply adding the Kallax shelving unit as an item you can use to organize your in-game house, the mod turns it into a companion that follows you around, holding an unlimited number of items on your behalf. Oh, and the Kallax is voiced by Matt Berry.

You can get a taste of the mod in the video below, showing off Berry's performance and even a modified version of the opening "You're finally awake" sequence. There are new items to obtain, including the Allenblade, which looks like a giant allen wrench, and the Meatball Helmet.

With the mod installed, there's a new series of quests that kicks off to find the parts to assemble the Kallax, eventually all culminating in a boss fight. To trigger the quest, you'll have to become over-encumbered, which raises the need for a walking, talking shelving unit in the first place.
points: I am not enthusiastic about what feels like an inevitable future wherein games and gaming subscription services are inundated with advertisements.
That said, I am excited to reinstall Skyrim so I can play an elaborate Ikea ad.

articles.title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword Is Getting an Official Prequel Webtoon With New Chapters Every Saturday
articles.summary: Onimusha: Way of the Sword dropped last week, and we’re of the opinion that it’s a 10/10 masterpiece. If you’ve already jumped into the action or are generally curious about the story side of things, it's worth checking out the official companion webcomic.
body: The entire Onimusha series takes place in an alternate version of Japan’s feudal era. In the game’s canon timeline, Way of the Sword picks up over two decades after the previous mainline release, Dawn of Dreams, bringing the world of Genma into the Edo period.

The companion webcomic, subtitled "Fated Rivalry," picks up pretty soon before the main events of Way of the Sword. The story follows Miyamoto Musashi's rival, Sasaki Ganryu, who discovers an Oni Gauntlet on his vengeance-driven quest to become powerful enough to take down Musashi.

The prequel is being produced by Laurel Pursuit, a US-based studio that’s previously distributed the Dungeon Crawler Carl graphic novel as well as original webcomics like Defiance of the Fall. The Ominusha webcomic specifically features work from Webtoon creators jjolee, hilluhri, and BAEKSSE.

The first chapter was released this past Saturday and has amassed just over 20,000 clicks so far. Future chapters will continue to become available on Saturdays, though it’s unclear how long the full prequel webcomic will end up being.
points: Onimusha: Way of the Sword dropped last week, and we’re of the opinion that it’s a 10/10 masterpiece.

articles.title: How Many Guest Characters Is Too Many? Tokyo Revengers X City of the Wolves Collaboration Sparks Fighting Game Debate
articles.summary: The fighting game community is in the middle of a fierce debate over the amount of guest characters coming to Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves. On September 9, SNK announced two more guest characters coming to City of the Wolves: Manjiro "Mikey" Sano and Ken "Draken" Ryuguji from Tokyo Revengers.
body: That’s a lot of guest characters for a game that’s only a little more than a year old — and while Ken and Chun-Li make sense given Capcom and SNK’s wealth of crossovers over the years, five guest characters from totally unrelated franchises feels a bit excessive to some players (myself included).

There’s a trend sweeping through popular fighting games lately where non-fighting game characters are being included in major titles like Street Fighter 6, Tekken 8, and of course, City of the Wolves. For example, Final Fantasy 7’s Tifa Lockhart is coming to Street Fighter 6 next year, while Baki’s Yujiro Hanma is set to make a splash in Tekken 8 in 2027.

While these one-off characters aren’t ruffling too many feathers within the fighting game community (Tekken is a franchise known for including one or two oddball guests), the sheer amount of guest characters in CotW is raising eyebrows — especially given the fact that they don’t come from other fighting games.
“Lmfaoo, adding anything bruh. Kenshiro was dope, but what the f**k is this,” one player wrote on X.

body: Players can unlock an achievement called "HEY NOW, YOU'RE AN ALL STAR..." by accumulating 25,000 kills in the Versus multiplayer mode. This Achievement provides 25 Gamerscore.

The most difficult Achievement to unlock appears to be "Dead Serious," which requires players to 100% the campaign on the highest difficulty, Insane, reach 25,000 kills in Versus, achieve max player level, and max out four classes. Players who do that will be rewarded with 85 Gamerscore, which is the most for any single Achievement in the game.

It is a big year for both Xbox and Shrek, as both celebrate their 25th anniversaries this year. The original Shrek movie was re-released in theaters this past summer, and Shrek himself showed up in various video games. As for Xbox, the biggest news event for the 25th anniversary has been Microsoft's decision to lay off thousands of people, close development studios, and cancel games.

articles.title: We’ve Never Seen Anything Like This In Call Of Duty Before
articles.summary: Activision has revealed new information about one of the perks for preordering Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, and it's a bit unusual. People who preorder the game on any platform get the Inner Circuit M4 weapon blueprint, but those who preorder on Xbox will get a translucent OG green version of…
body: If you preorder MW4 on any other platform, you'll get the same gun, but without the Xbox flourishes. Not only that, but if you're playing on PlayStation or Switch 2, you won't even see the translucent Xbox design. Only people playing on Xbox will.
Both versions of the gun are functionally identical, however, featuring the same attachments and gameplay characteristics.
Beyond this exclusive weapon variant, Microsoft is rewarding Xbox MW4 players by offering them a $5 credit to buy it on Xbox.

Microsoft owns Activision and the Call of Duty franchise, so this kind of exclusive offering makes sense. When Microsoft bought the franchise, it promised regulators that it would not water down Call of Duty games for platforms outside of Xbox, claiming 100% parity between platforms.

articles.title: Xbox Gets Exclusive Call of Duty Gun Skin PlayStation Players Can't See
articles.summary: The console war has found a new battlefield, and this time it’s the latest Call of Duty entry. Xbox players are getting a special Modern Warfare 4 gun skin that PlayStation and PC players literally cannot see.
body: Activision just announced the “Inner Circuit” M4 blueprint as a bonus for anyone who digitally pre-orders Modern Warfare 4.
While everyone gets the same weapon blueprint with identical stats, Xbox players get a very different-looking version.

The Xbox-exclusive treatment celebrates the console’s 25th anniversary with a translucent green design inspired by the original Xbox, complete with Xbox branding on the magazine. On Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, and Windows PC, the same weapon instead has a more traditional mil-spec appearance.
A console-exclusive skin on its own isn't odd, but here's where things get weird: The Xbox version isn't visible to anyone playing on another platform.

articles.title: Blizzard Workers Win Historic Union Contract That Could Set A New Standard For Game Developers
articles.summary: A group of 1,900 employees at Blizzard Entertainment has successfully signed a union contract with Microsoft, securing several guarantees for members. Represented by the Communications Workers of America (CWA), the contract has given the Blizzard workers more workplace flexibility and guaranteed…
body: One of the big wins for the Blizzard union is artificial intelligence guardrails, as the contract stipulates that Microsoft cannot use AI to automate or replace jobs without first talking to the union. Another big win are the job-recall rights for employees, because if they're laid off, Blizzard must offer them an open role within 14 months and inside the union's network before hiring someone from outside. Laid-off union members will also get an additional four weeks of pay--regardless of how long they worked at the company--hybrid schedules that allow them to work from home, and formal systems to settle disputes within the workplace.

"It's a new day at Blizzard, where greater power for workers is translating into more innovative games for players," CWA president Claude Cummings, Jr. said to Game Developer. "I am so proud of CWA bargaining teams, taking on tough fights and winning strong contracts that set new standards for working people across our industries."

articles.title: Zelda: Ocarina of Time Is the Last Game That Needs a Jump Button
articles.summary: After months of anticipation, Nintendo officially revealed footage for its upcoming remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time. The big reveal took place as part of Tuesday’s 40th anniversary stream for the Legend of Zelda, which opened with an orchestral take on the franchise theme and spent…
body: Judging from the substantial footage shown, Ocarina of Time on Switch 2 is a 1:1 remake, aside from a visual overhaul and some smart additions, similar to Starfox from earlier this year. One of the additions I’m less excited about, though, is the introduction of a dedicated jump button that Ocarina of Time doesn’t need.

In Ocarina of Time on the Nintendo 64, Link negotiated his fair share of platforms. From the very start of the adventure, he jumped between ledges, such as the small islands in a pond in Kokiri Forest. However, the player didn’t control those hops. Instead, they directed Link to run toward the edge of a platform and then he would automatically take a wild leap from its edge, all on his own.

articles.title: New Professor Layton Game Finally Gets a Release Date After Years of Delays
articles.summary: On Wednesday, Level-5's puzzle-adventure game Professor Layton and the New World of Steam received a 2026 release date following a full-year delay. Over the years, due to a lack of new information on the latest Professor Layton game, fans began to lose hope and expected the date to be pushed back…
body: Professor Layton and his trusted assistant Luke return in an all-new installment of the puzzle-solving adventure series set at the dawn of the industrial age. After receiving a letter from Luke, the professor travels to Steam Bison, a rapidly developing American town plagued by mysterious incidents.

Professor Layton and the New World of Steam is the first new mainline entry in the series since 2013's Professor Layton and the Azran Legacy, the final chapter in the Layton prequel trilogy. Between that game — released for Nintendo 3DS — and New World of Steam, publisher Level-5 has released a series of spinoffs and crossovers: Layton Brothers: Mystery Room, Professor Layton vs. Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney, Layton's Mystery Journey: Katrielle and the Millionaires' Conspiracy. Soon, the professor will enter his sequel era with New World of Steam.
Level-5 announced Professor Layton and the New World of Steam back in 2023. At the time of its reveal, the game was expected to arrive sometime in 2024.

articles.title: After 43 years, Dragon Quest creator Yuji Horii is making a surprise sequel to his NES murder mystery game
articles.summary: This week's dual-pronged Nintendo Direct shows were stuffed with huge games. Kirby and the World Beyond! Metroid Ravenous! The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time! But the Japanese version of today's show quietly snuck in at least one game the rest of us didn't get: a sequel to Dragon Quest creator…
body: The Portopia Serial Murder Case came out a whopping 43 years ago - first on your personal computers, then on the NES - and the murder mystery romp went on to become a pretty big hit for Enix (now Square Enix ). Even Hideo Kojima once credited it as one of the reasons why he wanted to begin making games in the first place.

And in today's Nintendo Direct, we got a brand-new trailer for a sequel to The Portopia Serial Murder Case. The text-based detective work and witness interrogations from the original seem to be intact, alongside a new string of murders. Check it out below.

The Steam page also notes that Yuji Horii is supervising the project as an executive director, though there's sadly no sign of English-language support just yet. We should hear more as the game approaches its 2027 release window on Switch 2 and PC.

articles.title: Nintendo Direct Just Proved Fans Will Be Eating Good in 2027
articles.summary: Hot on the heels of an event marking the 40th anniversary of The Legend of Zelda series, Nintendo treated fans to a second consecutive day of announcements. The Sept. 9 Nintendo Direct was more heavy on ports, updates, and previously announced titles than some people would have preferred.
body: No, I don't mean cooking and crafting minigames. I mean literally ingesting creatures and items as food.

Meanwhile, Metroid Ravenous finds Samus stranded on an unfamiliar moon, where it's kill or be killed. The game looks to integrate crunchy 2D platforming with splashy 3D cutscenes, and our intrepid bounty hunter must ingest her grody, tentacular opponents in order to escape. According to the game's official site, "To survive this hostile environment, Samus must use her latent Metroid powers to regain energy by feeding on her prey. Stun enemies by countering their attacks, then act fast to drain their energy." She is, quite literally, ravenous. Hope she kept a bottle of ranch dressing or sriracha in her ship for these kinds of emergencies!

articles.title: Valheim 1.0's Steam player count soars to a huge 5-year high, but it's not enough to beat the viral survival game's early access peak
articles.summary: The five-year wait for Valheim 1.0 doesn't seem to have hurt the survival game behemoth's popularity all that much. After leaving early access, the crafty viking sim is enjoying a huge resurgence in Steam player numbers.
body: Still, Valheim hasn't been able to capture lightning in a bottle twice. At least, not yet. The game peaked over five years ago when 502,387 people logged on at the same time, aided by memes that sailed across the web and a playerbase that wasn't totally pandemic-free yet.

Today's Steam stats may also be skewed by the fact that Iron Gate's breakout game is now available to play on PS5, Nintendo Switch 2 and Xbox Series X/S consoles. The Valheim crowd on Steam no longer represents the entire Valheim crowd, then. We'll see how high those numbers soar as the game heads into its first proper weekend of release.

The Valheim 1.0 update arguably matches the game's incredible launch stats, too. Iron Gate's new patch notes are almost 1,800 words long and include too much new newness for me to neatly summarise here. Long story short, if you've not touched the procgen afterlife in a while, Valheim 1.0 adds a new biome called Deep North, over 40 fresh weapons, lots of new bits and bobs and hammers to craft, a graphics setting to stretch draw distances, and much more.

articles.title: Almost 1,900 Blizzard workers vote through a "historic" union contract securing protections against layoffs and gen-AI
articles.summary: Around 1,900 unionised workers at Blizzard Entertainment have voted to ratify their first contract with the World of Warcraft publisher after years of negotiations. The union contract means Blizzard now has to bargain with staff over the use of generative-AI in game development, and workers also…
body: The contract covers all union-represented staff across the World of Warcraft, Warcraft Rumble, Hearthstone, Overwatch and Diablo teams, as well as people from Blizzard's QA, Platform and Technology, and Story and Franchise Development units. Some rare good news in the gaming world!

The Communications Workers of America labor union called the new contract "historic" in a recent press release and explained that Blizzard is now required to "discuss, evaluate, and bargain over the usage of artificial intelligence in the workplace." In a first for the video game industry, the contract has also given staff "the right to be 'recalled' into open positions across any Blizzard bargaining unit for 14 months from the date of their layoff announcement." Union members secured an extra four weeks of severance as part of the negotiations, as well, in the event of any layoffs.
